questions.stem: 本题的关键提示是“Check the rule for Linking sentences.”。哪一项与材料一致？.

options.text: It reads the example as a fixed label rather than a rule-governed form.
options.misconception: treats an example as a fixed label

options.text: It assumes the pattern continues unchanged in every context.
options.misconception: selects "It assumes the pattern continues unchanged in…" where the rule in the passage requires a different condition

options.text: It ignores the topic and relies on surface word order alone.
options.misconception: reverses the direction of the reasoning the passage sets out

options.text: It follows the stated rule for this topic without adding an extra step.

questions.explanation: What settles the item is the relation stated in the passage: the correct option states the rule for this topic. On that basis "It follows the stated rule for this topic without adding an extra step" is the supported choice. Option A ("It reads the example as a fixed label rather than a…") fails because it treats an example as a fixed label; Option B ("It assumes the pattern continues unchanged in every context") fails because it selects "It assumes the pattern continues unchanged in…" where linking sentences requires a different condition; Option C ("It ignores the topic and relies on surface word order alone") fails because it reverses the direction of the reasoning that settles linking sentences.
